discription: A bell-like tone generated using frequency modulation with a short, percussive envelope. It has a bright attack and a ringing decay.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, modRatio=2.0, modIndex=1.0; var sig, mod; var env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(0.001, 0.1, 0.5, 0.8, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2); mod = SinOsc.ar(freq * modRatio) * (freq * modIndex); sig = SinOsc.ar(freq + mod) * amp * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
